Package com.acxiom.emailaudit.reporting

Class ReportManager

java.lang.Object
com.acxiom.emailaudit.reporting.ReportManager
public final class ReportManager extends Object
Central reporting facade that builds and flushes a single ExtentReports Spark HTML dashboard for the entire audit run.

Architecture contract

Per Architecture.md: rules never interact with reporting. ReportManager only receives aggregated RuleResult lists from the orchestration layer — it never calls rule logic itself.

Dashboard layout

  Dashboard
   └─ Test: <filename>                     (one per HTML file)
       ├─ Node: CATEGORY / RULE_ID          (one per rule result)
       │    ├─ PASS / FAIL / ERROR / SKIPPED status
       │    ├─ Finding messages             (FAIL only)
       │    └─ Screenshot                   (when path supplied)
       └─ Summary attributes               (metrics written to test)

Thread safety

  • ExtentReports is not thread-safe for test creation. A ReentrantLock serialises all calls to ExtentReports.createTest(java.lang.Class<? extends com.aventstack.extentreports.gherkin.model.IGherkinFormatterModel>, java.lang.String, java.lang.String).
  • ExtentTest child nodes are created on the same test object from a single thread (the file-processing thread), so no additional locking is needed per test.
  • flush() is guarded by the same lock; calling it while another thread is still writing tests is safe.
  • Summary counters use AtomicInteger for lock-free increments from parallel file-processing threads.

Configuration keys

report.output.dir Directory for the HTML report (default: target/audit-reports)
report.title Dashboard browser-tab title (default: Email Audit Report)
report.name Heading shown inside the dashboard (default: Audit Run)

  • Method Details

    • recordFileResults

      public void recordFileResults(String fileName, List<RuleResult> results, Path screenshotPath)
      Records the audit results for a single HTML file as a top-level test in the Spark dashboard.

      One child node is created per RuleResult. Failing and erroring nodes include all finding messages. If screenshotPath is non-null and the file exists, it is embedded in the test node.

      Parameters:
      fileName - display name for the test (typically the HTML file name)
      results - aggregated rule results for this file; must not be null
      screenshotPath - optional path to a PNG screenshot; may be null

    • recordFileResults

      public void recordFileResults(String fileName, List<RuleResult> results)
      Convenience overload for callers that have no screenshot.
      Parameters:

      results - aggregated rule results for this file

    • flush

      public Path flush()
      Flushes all buffered test data to the HTML report file and appends a run-level summary section.

      Must be called exactly once after all files have been processed. Subsequent calls are safe (ExtentReports re-writes the same file).

      Returns:
      absolute path of the written HTML report file

    • getReportPath

      public Path getReportPath()

      Returns:
